## Checklist

- [ ] Follows AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and the language standard for the files touched
- [ ] Frontend `npm run check` and/or backend Ruff, mypy, and pytest pass locally (when those scripts exist)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] No new dependencies (or justified below)
- [ ] No unused code, debug logs, or commented-out blocks
- [ ] Reused existing helpers instead of duplicating
- [ ] No secrets or credentials
- [ ] Privacy: no individual rankings, no private answers on admin views, complete ≠ share
- [ ] No TypeScript (`.ts` / `.tsx`) on the frontend; JSDoc on public JS exports
- [ ] No boolean-trap flags; writes are idempotent; routers and presentational UI stay thin
- [ ] I have read and understood every line I am submitting
